node.title: Re: Intermittent bug in module: File not getting deleted as expected
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: In addition to what [stevieb] [id://1230174|said] about the -M test, which does seem a likely candidate (remember it depends on the behavior of the filesystem), I also see you aren't checking [doc://unlink] for success or failure. For the former issue, you might want to add some kind of "force" parameter to cleanup to skip the -M test overall and just delete all files, that way the test will be more deterministic.
